title: Stable Reduction of Unresolved Dynamics: An Operator-Theoretic Framework
summary: Dimension reduction removes variables, but a reliable reduction should not erase their dynamical influence. We study this principle for linear block evolution systems on resolved and unresolved Hilbert spaces. Exact elimination of the unresolved component yields a Volterra equation with a memory kernel and an effective forcing term carrying hidden initial data and forcing; in the Laplace domain the same operation is a dynamic Schur complement.
